description: List the assets in the register with cost, method, rate and net book value at a date, filtered by scheme, category, project, currency or disposal state. Free and unlimited.

as_of.description: Value the register at this month or date, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

category.description: Only assets in this table category code or name

currency.description: Only assets held in this currency

include_disposed.description: Include assets already disposed of. Default false

project.description: Only assets on this project or cost centre

scheme.description: Only assets on this tax scheme

name: asset_list
title: List the fixed asset register
